messages:
laura: Quick heads-up — AWS Marketplace contact + a HW SI (EdgeAccel) asked if we can bundle: Gateway adapter + Dedicated reserved capacity + 1yr support. Want a partner-facing pricing & launch plan. Anyone on this?

mike: I can take pricing for the bundle. Need product constraints from ana and an infra checklist from chris.

ana: We need to decide what "bundle" actually includes. Is Gateway a managed addon or licensed adapter? Also, do we certify HW image for on-prem? :thinking_face: 

chris: From infra side: Dedicated reserved capacity + VPC networking + KMS integration is doable. On-prem image certification will add ~4w for validation on EdgeAccel hardware.

jules: FYI EdgeAccel expects co-marketing and a joint announcement. They asked for a 2-week preview into their channel. We should lock messaging before preview.

laura: Agenda for quick sync: 1) bundle components 2) pricing floor & discounts 3) partner pilot timeline 4) certification blockers 5) announcement cadence. Can we do 30m tomorrow?

mike: Tomorrow works. Draft pricing to start:
```
Gateway adapter license: $25k/yr
Dedicated reserve (small pool): $10k/mo (committed 12mo)
Support & integration: $8k one-time
Partner discount: 20% initial pilot
```
Numbers are placeholders — need product signoff.

ana: Those numbers seem reasonable as a starting point. Need to map them to SKU lines in marketplace and whether we expose monthly vs annual. For AWS Marketplace we'll likely need both AMI + SaaS listing entries.

chris: Technical checklist for certification:
- Run our inference smoke tests on EdgeAccel 8xA100 image
- Validate KV cache persistence in their environment
- Confirm driver/kernel versions + CUDA compatibility
- Provide deployment manifest + helm chart for their infra
I'll slot this into eng backlog but need ETA from EdgeAccel on test hardware.

jules: Marketing asks: partner-ready one-pager, joint blog draft, and a co-branded launch slide. I'll start a google doc and loop legal for co-announcement approvals. Link: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-bundle-doc

laura: Good. Action items: mike draft formal pricing + SKU map, ana to confirm bundle components and licensing model, chris to publish cert checklist and ETA request to EdgeAccel, jules to start comms doc. I'll schedule 30m tomorrow 10:30am PT. Please drop any blockers here. :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Reminder: When creating Marketplace listings, include the following tags: "redwood-gateway", "dedicated-reserve", "edge-accel".

mike: One blocker: need legal on reseller clauses for SI bundling. Can legal join the sync or share a quick template?

ana: I'll ping legal and ask them to either join or drop a template.

laura: Perfect — thanks all. Sync invite sent.
